description: The pie chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of generative AI applications in journalism as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It is divided into two segments: a large red segment labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and a smaller yellow segment labeled “Headline generation (16.8%).” The chart uses a donut-style layout with a white center containing the title “Task Type” in bold black text. The percentages are clearly labeled next to each segment, and the red segment, representing article generation, dominates the chart, visually emphasizing its prevalence over headline generation. No legend is present, as the labels are directly associated with their respective slices. The chart effectively conveys that article generation is the primary task type in the studied use cases of generative AI in journalism, accounting for over four-fifths of the total.
